reviews.text: Superb customer service all the way. Mike is a top notch groomer in our books! He delivered exactly what requested- teddy bear face, lamb legs and all. So thankful to Jessica and Boy for directing us their way.            ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I can honestly say that the staff at Lucy’s love my dog as much as I do! I get regular texts on her activities and well being. It’s never leaving a loved member of my family to someone else’s care, but I have the utmost respect for the loving staff at Lucy’s that Gracie will be loved and cared for as if she were with me.

I can’t say enough great things about this dog pet retreat and spa! From the moment you walk in, you can tell they truly care about every dog that comes through their doors. The staff is incredibly friendly, attentive, and treats each pet like their own. The grooming services are top-tier—my dog Braxton always comes back looking amazing, clean, and happy. 🐶💙✨

Frustrating experience. My husband dropped our dog off around 8:15 and had to get to work by 1:30. We called around noon to check in and they said they hadn’t started on her yet. The girl said she’d be wrapped up by 1 at the latest. He showed up at 1 and she hadn’t been taken back yet. In order to pick her up and leave the facility, they charged a $10 fee because they “brushed her”. Why are dogs sitting there for 5 hours? I understand groomers work on multiple pups and multitask, but to this excess seems like a time management issue.

*Edit: increasing my review due to the thoughtful response and explanation of the miscommunication we had over the phone. We will try again here in the future.
Jade is a Lucky Dog regular. She goes for day care and grooming. She is Australian, but this week she will be Irish Lucky ☘️ at Lucky Dog.

I took my goldendoodle in last week following a very long road trip. I asked and paid for the full groom. 140.00, and I added a 20%tip on top of that. When I picked her up, she was so excited and ready to go so I didn’t look her over closely. The cut was very cute, but after we left I noticed the ears were not cleaned, and the hair on the ears was still very oily. I also noticed they didn’t trim her paws and the hair was very thick between her toes. They also failed to trim her tail at all, which had some mats left in it. I called the salon and just got a recording, I sent pictures of this to the person I had been texting regarding drop off and pick up, and as of yet have gotten no response from anyone. It just seems very unprofessional and I will not be returning.
They really love dogs. I find that vary reassuring when I travel without my pet.

I have 3 poodles and they do a really good job with them. I’ve always been able to get in really fast. The staff is very friendly and actually seem to enjoy their jobs. I only wish they offered a multi dog discount. 😥
Very friendly staff

Went for the 1st time and absolutely loved it! The front desk employee was extremely kind over the phone and in-person. The groomer did a fantastic job on my pup. She left smiling from ear to ear. Will come back!!! 🩷🐾

Friendly, proffessional.
Thank you, Jackie!
Love getting my dogs groomed here. Excellent service and friendly staff!!
Maggie absolutely loves to come to her “spa day”. Thank you so much for taking such good care of her!
My Cocoa loves this place and so do I! Thank you for being so wonderful to my furbaby!
Just picked up my mini Australian Shepherd from a full groom and she looks great! Super friendly staff who cared well for my pup! 🐶 …

They are always amazing!
My 2 mini schnauzers are always happy to stay, the staff is very nice and lovely.
Lucky dog pet grooming is awesome! They do such a good job and truly care about the animals.

Update:
The owner Nicole was amazing! Her customer service will make me a return customer. I will be bringing Syre back and continue to allow the groomers to practice on the standard cut for the breed. Like I said before bad haircuts aren’t the worse and it’ll always grow back. But finding somewhere that truly appreciates their customers is hard to find. I can confirm that Lucky Dog Pet Retreat and Spa values my business.

Moved here from Dallas and trying to find our new grooming home for my Black Russian Terrier. The employees were nice nd kept me updated including calling to explain that we would have to go shorter on the legs due to some matting. This was expected as I explained he had been outside quite a bit recently in the country. When picking him up I was informed of the $175 cost. Which was much higher than I’ve ever paid as a full groom in Dallas is usually about $115. I didn’t complain and included a tip. For their prices the haircut is amateur and they considered it a “luxury style” there is zero transition in the cut and he looks as if I did it myself. The area between his hips looks like a landing strip. I can deal with a bad haircut because his breed is rare and most groomers and vets have never heard of the breed. But he still STINKS. BAD. When I looked him over his ears were NOT clean. And as the website states this is included in the full groom. I have included images of his haircut fails as well as the wipes from cleaning his ears after I spent $185! If you are someone expecting to get the level of service that you pay for I would consider looking for a more experienced groomer.
I’ve had my two poodles groomed here twice and have been really happy with the results. The staff is very nice and friendly, and the place is super clean. So far so good!
Great service, I own three pure breed Dobermans and staff are really good with handling them. They always remember their names. I have been using them for quite sometime now. I would recommend them.
Great staff and place
As always I have shad a great experience. They do take their time with my dog.

We love Lucky Dog. But even better, our fur baby Atticus loves Lucky Dog. Outstanding customer service and exceptional groomers.  Atticus had an appointment today and he looks fabulous. Thank you Lucky dog.
Excellent groomers, staff, and management! Our dog always looks great after his bath and monthly grooming. I highly recommend their services!

Lucky pet resort, Everyone is friendly. That treat and work with each pet as a individual. For dogs that need to build trust they are great and understanding. This is are second time but not last.

Thank You,
Brian Pashkoff
Very conscientious and courteous.  They do excellent work. My dog feels very comfortable and safe. My dog doesn't want to leave!
My dog loves this place and goes in skipping every time she has a grooming appointment. The staff is friendly and they do a terrific job.

Tux has only ever been to Lucky Dog Pet & Spa these last 5 years due to their continued exceptional services. I love knowing that he can be groomed, socialized, & boarded all in the same place & with continuous care. And if we ever want to check and see how he is doing, they provide cameras for us to see. Tux is always happy after a visit & that is all we could ask for. Thank You LDP&S. We wouldn’t know what to do without you. 🐾
